messages:
Alex (PM): quick heads-up — observed a leaky canary last night where ~2% EU traffic got routed to the new model variant despite the flag targeting only internal test tenants. :eyes:
Priya (SRE): ugh. any errors or latency spikes?
Alex (PM): error-rate fine, but tail latency for the affected requests jumped ~150ms for a subset of requests. looks correlated with long-context prompts from a single partner tenant.
Jon (eng-runtime): likely routing key mismatch — canary routing was supposed to use tenant_id header but fallback path used session_id. patch incoming.
Rina (product): we need a short-term containment plan + a robust rollout strategy so this doesn't recur during bigger launches. proposal: quarantine cohort approach + explicit traffic quarantine TTL and automatic circuit breaker by signal.
Marta (sales): flag this tenant — they reported a few client complaints this morning. want to know if we need to proactively reach out.
Ben (csm): I pinged the tenant; they're not seeing user-facing errors, but they noticed slower response for long prompts. I'll keep them posted.
Priya (SRE): quarantine cohort idea sounds good. specifics I'd want: 1) default canary size caps at 0.5% for cross-region launches, 2) quarantine window of 30 minutes, 3) automated rollback triggers (latency p99 > baseline + 100ms OR error-rate + 0.5%).
Sam (eng-ml): add a quality gate: hallucination/regression signal from eval harness on sampled outputs. if regressed on golden prompts by >2% we auto-fallback to previous model.
Jon (eng-runtime): technical notes: we can implement quarantine by marking canary routes with header X-quarantine:true and route through a dedicated pool that enforces token/time budgets. quick config snippet: ```
feature_flag: canary_x
  scope: region:eu
  cohort: quarantine
  size: 0.005
  ttl_minutes: 30
  signals:
    - p99_latency
    - error_rate
    - eval_regression
```
Rina (product): love the header approach. also want an A/B test variant where we compare quantized fallback vs model rollback for cost/quality tradeoffs. keep the canary traffic split deterministic by tenant to avoid cross-tenant leakage.
Alex (PM): action items I propose: 1) Jon — hotfix routing key and add X-quarantine header (ETA 2h) 2) Priya — create circuit-breaker alert with the thresholds above + a synthetic probe for long-context flows (ETA today) 3) Sam — add golden-prompt eval sampling and tie to rollback rule (ETA 24h) 4) Rina/Alex — update rollout doc with quarantine + A/B matrix and comms plan (ETA EOD)
Jon (eng-runtime): starting the hotfix now. will also add forced pinning for tenant header to prevent session_id fallback.
Priya (SRE): I'll add an interim runbook: if quarantine sees any p99 > baseline + 100ms OR >2 golden-regressions -> auto-scale-down canary to 0 and trigger on-call.
deploy-bot: deploy 2789456123-hotfix (eng-runtime) succeeded in prod eu (canary pool).
Marta (sales): thanks, Ben — I'll draft a short note to affected customers offering a postmortem once we validate fixes. keep me in loop. :thumbsup:
Ben (csm): noted. I'll pass on the immediate update and flag customers with SLA clauses.
Rina (product): small ask — let's also add a metric in console: "quarantine_traffic_ratio" and a checkbox in rollout UI to enable quarantine mode (defaults off).
Alex (PM): agreed. let's reconvene tomorrow 9am to sign off on the updated rollout playbook. for now we follow the quarantine ladder.
Sam (eng-ml): quick FYI — the eval harness detected a subtle tokenization mismatch causing longer KV cache behavior for that tenant's prompt shape. fix in flight.
Jon (eng-runtime): noted — will monitor KV cache metrics and add a temporary cache TTL cap for quarantine routes.
Priya (SRE): logging follow-up: tag all quarantine requests with trace id prefix QC- so we can slice quickly in dashboards.
Alex (PM): thanks everyone. final checklist in thread: Jon hotfix done? (yes). Priya alerts + runbook? (working). Sam eval tie-in? (in progress). Rina doc + comms? (in progress). we'll publish a short internal postmortem after the recon tomorrow.
Rina (product): +1. cc @marta for customer comms draft.
Marta (sales): on it.
Alex (PM): closing the thread for now — will post updates in here as they come.
